segments.name: Manufacture of PrepaCyte CB units
segments.description: Manufactures and sells PrepaCyte CB units, the processing technology used to process umbilical cord blood stem cells.
segments.evidence: the manufacture of PrepaCyte® CB Processing System ("PrepaCyte CB") units, the processing technology used to process umbilical cord blood stem cells

segments.name: Cellular processing and cryogenic storage of umbilical cord blood stem cells for
segments.description: Processes and stores umbilical cord blood stem cells for public use, sold to the National Marrow Donor Program for transplant centers.
segments.evidence: cellular processing and cryogenic storage of umbilical cord blood stem cells for public use

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for the private cord blood program and PrepaCyte CB units, licensees pay for selling the program abroad, and NMDP pays for public cord blood units.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenues for the cellular processing and cryogenic cellular storage represent sales of the umbilical cord blood stem cells program to customers and income from licensees selling the umbilical cord blood stem cells program to customers outside the United States.
